---
title: "gt Integration"
---

Gridwell integrates with [gt](https://gt.rstudio.com/) to render gt table objects to all 11
output formats from R.

## Quick Start

```r
library(gt)
library(gridwell)

tbl <- gt(exibble, rowname_col = "row", groupname_col = "group") |>
  tab_header(title = "Example", subtitle = "From exibble")

table_ptr <- gw_parse_ir(gt_to_ir(tbl))
html <- gw_render_html(table_ptr)
```

## Functions

### `gt_to_ir(gt_tbl)`

Converts a `gt_tbl` object to gridwell IR JSON string.

```r
ir_json <- gt_to_ir(tbl)
```

### `gt_to_ir_list(gt_tbl)`

Converts a `gt_tbl` object to an R list (IR structure).

```r
ir_list <- gt_to_ir_list(tbl)
```

## What Gets Converted

| gt Feature | IR Mapping |
|------------|-----------|
| Column labels (`_boxhead`) | `thead` rows |
| Row groups (`_row_groups`) | `tbody` array with group labels |
| Stub column (`rowname_col`) | Cells with `is_stub: true` |
| Title/subtitle (`_heading`) | `header` block |
| Source notes (`_source_notes`) | `footer.source_notes` |
| Column alignment | `column_spec[].align` |
| Column widths | `column_spec[].width` |
| Data values | Cell `content` and `typed_value` |

## Full Pipeline Example

```r
library(gt)
library(gridwell)

tbl <- gt(exibble, rowname_col = "row", groupname_col = "group") |>
  tab_header(title = "Example", subtitle = "Demo") |>
  tab_source_note(source_note = "Source: gt package")

table_ptr <- gw_parse_ir(gt_to_ir(tbl))

# Validate
errors <- gw_validate(table_ptr)
stopifnot(length(errors) == 0)

# Text formats
for (fmt in c("html", "latex", "typst", "rtf", "svg", "ansi", "pandoc", "quarto")) {
  result <- gw_render(table_ptr, fmt)
  cat(sprintf("  %s: %d chars\n", fmt, nchar(result)))
}

# Binary formats
for (fmt in c("docx", "xlsx", "pptx")) {
  data <- gw_render_binary(table_ptr, fmt)
  cat(sprintf("  %s: %d bytes\n", fmt, length(data)))
}
```
